facts.fact: 两周来 Clay 每次 Kayla 排班都来酒吧，只点头不搭话，Kayla 不知他从哪知道她的班表
facts.anchor: Clay comes to the bar every time I have a shift.

facts.fact: Vero 喝下墓地特调赢过与 Nixie 的赌约，换来新展区首次试用追逐
facts.anchor: We have a new exhibit opening tonight for a trial run. I bet Nixie I could drink a graveyard smoothie—she didn’t believe I could.

facts.fact: 迷彩服完全合身说明 Vero 记过她的尺寸，Kayla 分不清这算贴心还是不安
facts.anchor: Pulling on the camo pants, I find they fit me perfectly, which means Vero paid attention when he shouldn’t have, and I don’t know if that is sweet or unsettling.

facts.fact: Clay 自己开车来接人，用威胁口吻命令 Kayla 上车，Kayla 仍一路嘴硬回敬
facts.anchor: Get in the car, Kayla, before I get out and make you.

facts.fact: Brawley 把 Vero 的 paper-cut princess 简化成 Double P 作为她的代号
facts.anchor: Brawley chuckles. “Yeah, Vero calls you paper-cut princess, but I decided Double P sounds better.”

facts.fact: Kayla 故意打偏一枪落在 Clay 头侧，宣称自己从不失手、那只是警告弹
facts.anchor: “FYI, I never miss,” I say, lowering the gun and looking Clay dead in the eye. “That was a warning shot.”

facts.fact: Nixie 开赛前给出三条规则：Kayla 两分钟先发、不得越界、不许死人
facts.anchor: Nixie comes out and runs us through the safety briefing—a two-minute head start for me, stay inside the boundary markers, no dead bodies.

facts.fact: Kayla 命中 Clay 胸口后遭三人合围；Clay 回敬一枪打肩称扯平，她默许他这么以为
facts.anchor: He raises his gun and shoots me directly in the shoulder. “Now we’re even,” he says.
